name: Blue Souls
source:
They were blessed with emotions, knowledge and a promising life. Blessings, however, tend to come with a price. 

Blue Souls is the story of a city populated by animals who touched "The Blue". A mantis and a fly were recently blessed, and they must now learn how to survive in such a place as they discover themselves and what it means to be alive. 

[From [url=https://bside-stories.itch.io/blue-souls]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
他们拥有情感、知识和充满希望的生活。然而，祝福往往是有代价的。

《蓝色灵魂》讲述了一座居住着接触“蓝色”的动物的城市的故事。一只螳螂和一只苍蝇最近受到了祝福，它们现在必须学习如何在这样的地方生存，因为它们发现了自己以及活着意味着什么。

[来自[url=https://bside-stories.itch.io/blue-souls]itch.io[/url]]
